# Hull of a Party

> Balloon installations, venue decor and full event styling in Hull, run by Lily and Ellie.
> Hull born, party-ready across East Yorkshire.
> Tagline: we throw a Hull of a party.
> House rule no. 1: no pink (everyone does pink).

## Contact
- Email: hello@hullofaparty.co.uk
- Founders: Lily (the planner) and Ellie (the eye)
- Based in: Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire
- Areas covered: Hull, Beverley, Cottingham, Hessle, Willerby, Anlaby, Kirk Ella, Hedon, Brough and the wider East Riding
- Instagram / TikTok / Facebook: @hullofaparty

## What they do
- Balloons: arches, garlands, columns, number and letter stacks, balloon walls, ceiling fills, personalised bubbles
- Decor: backdrops, shimmer walls, table styling, centrepieces, light-up numbers, neon signs, themed props
- Full events: planning, theme design, venue dressing, setup before and takedown after
- Occasions: birthdays, weddings, baby showers, gender reveals, graduations, proms, engagements, christenings, corporate, retirements

## Pricing (guide)
- The Mini: from £45 (1.5m garland, delivered and fitted)
- The Showstopper: from £120 (arch or XL garland, backdrop, light-up number, setup and takedown)
- The Works: from £250 (complete venue styling with planning and theme design)
- Every party quoted properly, free, after a quick chat
